title: AlloyDB: 'edition' Deprecated, Use 'ExpressConfig'
summary: The `edition` field on AlloyDB `Backup` and `Cluster` schemas is now formally deprecated. Developers should migrate to using the `ExpressConfig` property, which has been added to the `Backup` schema as an output-only field.
details: The `edition` property, previously used to specify AlloyDB cluster editions, is now formally deprecated across both `Backup` and `Cluster` schemas. All associated enum values for `edition` are also deprecated, with explicit guidance to use `ExpressConfig` instead. As part of this transition, a new `expressConfig` property has been added to the `Backup` schema. This property is marked as read-only, reflecting the Express configuration of the cluster from which the backup was created. The API notes that `expressConfig` on `Backup` being immutable is considered a breaking change, so developers should ensure their code correctly handles this output-only field.
